title: Better Item Frames
description: You can now create better invisible Item Frames
body:
### **Better Item Frames**

**Should work in any Minecraft World**


This Datapack lets you create hovering Items to display in your World!
Here is how:

_
1. Place a regular item frame

2. Place another regular item frame in it

3. Right click the particles with any item to display it

4. If you want to change the item, just left click it to reset

5. If you want to remove it, left click it again
_
